# Architecture (AP-ARC)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-ARC-01

**Unapproved dependency** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-02, P-04.

**Why it hurts.** New packages, projects or framework references change the architecture and supply chain.

**Fix.** List the change under "Approved dependency changes" in plan.md, or remove it.

**Detection:** G7 package/project drift check.

## AP-ARC-02

**Wrapper without stable value** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-02, P-05.

**Why it hurts.** A thin wrapper around one Radzen component adds indirection without behaviour.

**Fix.** Use the Radzen component directly unless the wrapper enforces a repository convention.

## AP-ARC-03

**Unrelated refactoring inside a slice** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-11.

**Why it hurts.** Mixed changes are hard to review and roll back.

**Fix.** Keep the slice to its tasks; record other findings as out-of-scope.

## AP-ARC-04

**Repairing brownfield inconsistencies during feature work** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-02, P-11.

**Why it hurts.** Fixing unrelated architecture during a feature expands scope silently.

**Fix.** Record under out-of-scope findings in discovery.md.

## AP-ARC-05

**Data access from components** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-06, P-02.

**Why it hurts.** Injecting a DbContext into UI bypasses the application/service layer, validation and authorization.

**Fix.** Call the service/client used by the analogous feature. If the repository deliberately uses DbContext in components, waive with that evidence.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `@inject\s+(IDbContextFactory<\w+>|\w*DbContext)\b|\[Inject\][^\n]*\b(IDbContextFactory<\w+>|\w*DbContext)\b`.

## AP-ARC-06

**Global state for local state** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-02.

**Why it hurts.** Introducing a store for state that belongs to one component adds complexity.

**Fix.** Keep local state in the component or follow the repository state pattern.
